Bug_Title: NP: Method does not check for null argument (NP_ARGUMENT_MIGHT_BE_NULL)
Bug_Details:
A parameter to this method has been identified as a value that should
always be checked to see whether or not it is null, but it is being dereferenced
without a preceding null check.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the length of the input string is being calculated without checking if the input string is null. This can result in a NullPointerException if the input string is null.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the showBug method is called with a null argument, which causes a NullPointerException because the method does not check if the input is null before getting its length.
